tools.name: get_ayah
tools.description: The Arabic of one ayah or a run of them (up to 50), with a translation. The Arabic is the Uthmani text with every mark and its ayah number; quote it exactly as given. Defaults to the King Fahd Complex English (Hilali & Muhsin Khan).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Ayahs containing the words given: in the Arabic (diacritics optional) or, with "translation", in that translation; words with no Arabic letter search the English (Hilali & Khan) unless a translation is named. Up to 50 results, each with its reference and link.

tools.name: get_tafsir
tools.description: The Tafsir al-Muyassar (King Fahd Complex, Arabic) of one ayah or a run of them, up to 50.

tools.name: word_by_word
tools.description: Each word of an ayah: its Latin reading and its meaning, in English or one of the other languages that have word meanings.

tools.name: get_recitation
tools.description: The recording of a surah: a link to the MP3, its length, and where each ayah starts and ends, in seconds, with a link that starts at a given ayah, or plays a run of ayahs and stops.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Links to download a surah's files: "text", the Arabic (optionally with a translation and the Tafsir al-Muyassar) as a .txt; "audio", its recording as an MP3 (leave out the surah for all of a reciter's); "timing", where each ayah and word of a recording starts and ends, as JSON; "font", the mushaf's

tools.name: list_surahs
tools.description: All 114 surahs: number, names, ayah count and mushaf pages.

tools.name: list_translations
tools.description: The translations on offer, optionally for one language: id, language, translator. Also which languages have word-by-word meanings.

tools.name: list_reciters
tools.description: The recordings on offer: id, reciter, and what tells two recordings by one voice apart.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send the reader's report to readqurantoday.com: a problem with the site's text, a translation, the tafsir or a recitation, or a suggestion. Only when the reader asks to report or suggest something; send what they said, in their words, and the ayah or reciter it is about. Never on your own initiative

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "get_file" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_ayah" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
